question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**reform**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses a change in the structure and function of the World Bank, specifically a shift away from a donor-recipient model towards a more equitable partnership.
 
• The word **reform** refers to making changes or improvements to an institution or system, which fits with the context of restructuring the World Bank to make it more effective and fair.
 
• Other options like **reckon**, **resign**, and **redeem** do not align with the context of making significant changes or improvements to the World Bank's structure and operations.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The US is the (1) **biggest **__shareholder in the World Bank and traditionally, the bank’s president has been a US citizen (2) __**nominated **__by Washington. Small island developing states have argued for moving the fund (3) __**away **__from a donor recipient model, with all their usual power imbalances, (4) __**towards **__a partnership founded on a shared commitment to protecting the planet. This will require partial or total (5)__reform__ of the World Bank. This is already happening under its new president, some argue. But hosting the fund within the bank would still give donor countries disproportionate influence.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reckon** means to think or believe, which doesn't fit the context of making changes or improvements to an institution.
 
• **Resign** means to quit a position, which does not align with the idea of changing the structure or operations of the World Bank.
 
• **Redeem** refers to making something right, often in a moral sense, but does not align with the context of restructuring an organization.
